description: داشبورد متكامل لمؤشرات النمو مع فلتر موحّد: يومي/شهري/تراكمي.

card.description: مجموع total_price. يدعم الفلتر: يومي/شهري/تراكمي — HameemDB.
card.name: المبيعات

stages.native:
WITH g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ELSE DATE(created_at) END AS period, SUM(CAST(total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) n
           FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT period, ROUND(CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative' THEN SUM(n) OVER (ORDER BY period) ELSE n END,2) AS sales
FROM g ORDER BY period

card.description: عدد الحجوزات (كل الحالات). يدعم الفلتر: يومي/شهري/تراكمي — HameemDB.
card.name: عدد الطلبات

stages.native:
WITH g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ELSE DATE(created_at) END AS period, COUNT(*) n FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT period, CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative' THEN SUM(n) OVER (ORDER BY period) ELSE n END AS orders
FROM g ORDER BY period

card.description: طلبات الباقة (use_package=1) ونسبتها. يدعم الفلتر: يومي/شهري/تراكمي — HameemDB.
card.name: طلبات الباقات (هدف 40%)

stages.native:
WITH g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ELSE DATE(created_at) END AS period, SUM(use_package=1) pkg, COUNT(*) tot
           FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT period,
  CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative' THEN SUM(pkg) OVER (ORDER BY period) ELSE pkg END AS package_orders,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative' THEN 100*SUM(pkg) OVER (ORDER BY period)/NULLIF(SUM(tot) OVER (ORDER BY period),0)
             ELSE 100*pkg/NULLIF(tot,0) END,1) AS package_pct
FROM g ORDER BY period

card.description: الغسلة المفردة (use_package=0) ونسبتها. يدعم الفلتر: يومي/شهري/تراكمي — HameemDB.
card.name: طلبات الغسلة المفردة (هدف 60%)

stages.native:
WITH g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ELSE DATE(created_at) END AS period, SUM(use_package=0) sgl, COUNT(*) tot
           FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT period,
  CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative' THEN SUM(sgl) OVER (ORDER BY period) ELSE sgl END AS single_orders,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative' THEN 100*SUM(sgl) OVER (ORDER BY period)/NULLIF(SUM(tot) OVER (ORDER BY period),0)
             ELSE 100*sgl/NULLIF(tot,0) END,1) AS single_pct
FROM g ORDER BY period

card.description: عدد خطوط الخدمة (بدون منتجات) ÷ الطلبات. يدعم الفلتر: يومي/شهري/تراكمي — HameemDB.
card.name: متوسط الغسلات لكل طلب

stages.native:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ELSE DATE(r.created_at) END AS period,
         SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(rs.is_product,0)=0 AND COALESCE(rs.is_deleted,0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) washes,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) orders
  FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN reservation_service rs ON rs.reservation_id=r.id
  WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT period, ROUND(CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative'
         THEN SUM(washes) OVER (ORDER BY period)/NULLIF(SUM(orders) OVER (ORDER BY period),0)
         ELSE washes/NULLIF(orders,0) END,2) AS washes_per_order
FROM g ORDER BY period

card.description: متوسط الأيام من شراء الباقة حتى آخر غسلة منها. يدعم الفلتر: يومي/شهري/تراكمي — HameemDB.
card.name: زمن استهلاك الباقة (أيام)

stages.native:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT ps.id, ps.created_at sc, MAX(r.created_at) lu
  FROM package_subscriptions ps JOIN reservations r ON r.subscription_id=ps.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE ps.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY ps.id, ps.created_at),
g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(sc,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ELSE DATE(sc) END AS period, SUM(DATEDIFF(lu,sc)) sum_days, COUNT(*) cnt FROM s WHERE lu IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT period, ROUND(CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative'
         THEN SUM(sum_days) OVER (ORDER BY period)/NULLIF(SUM(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY period),0)
         ELSE sum_days/NULLIF(cnt,0) END,1) AS avg_days_to_consume
FROM g ORDER BY period

card.description: الإيراد ÷ الطلبات المدفوعة (use_package=0). يدعم الفلتر: يومي/شهري/تراكمي — HameemDB.
card.name: متوسط قيمة الطلب (AOV)

stages.native:
WITH g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ELSE DATE(created_at) END AS period, SUM(CAST(total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) rev, COUNT(*) orders
           FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND use_package=0 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT period, ROUND(CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative'
         THEN SUM(rev) OVER (ORDER BY period)/NULLIF(SUM(orders) OVER (ORDER BY period),0)
         ELSE rev/NULLIF(orders,0) END,2) AS aov
FROM g ORDER BY period

card.description: الحجوزات المكتملة (status=3). يدعم الفلتر: يومي/شهري/تراكمي — HameemDB.
card.name: الغسلات المكتملة

stages.native:
WITH g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ELSE DATE(created_at) END AS period, COUNT(*) n FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status=3 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT period, CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative' THEN SUM(n) OVER (ORDER BY period) ELSE n END AS completed
FROM g ORDER BY period

card.description: طلبات العملاء العائدين (الطلب الثاني فأكثر) ونسبتها. يدعم الفلتر: يومي/شهري/تراكمي — HameemDB.
card.name: تكرار الشراء (Repeat)

stages.native:
WITH r AS (SELECT client_id, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY created_at) rn
           FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL),
g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ELSE DATE(created_at) END AS period, SUM(rn>1) repeat_orders, COUNT(*) tot FROM r GROUP BY 1)
SELECT period,
  CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative' THEN SUM(repeat_orders) OVER (ORDER BY period) ELSE repeat_orders END AS repeat_orders,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative' THEN 100*SUM(repeat_orders) OVER (ORDER BY period)/NULLIF(SUM(tot) OVER (ORDER BY period),0)
             ELSE 100*repeat_orders/NULLIF(tot,0) END,1) AS repeat_rate_pct
FROM g ORDER BY period

card.description: الطلبات ÷ عدد العملاء. يدعم الفلتر: يومي/شهري/تراكمي — HameemDB.
card.name: متوسط الطلبات لكل عميل (AOPU)

stages.native:
WITH firsts AS (SELECT client_id, MIN(created_at) fc FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY client_id),
pa AS (SELECT CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ELSE DATE(created_at) END AS period, COUNT(*) orders, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) users
       FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1),
nu AS (SELECT CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='monthly' THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(fc,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ELSE DATE(fc) END AS period, COUNT(*) newu FROM firsts GROUP BY 1)
SELECT pa.period, ROUND(CASE WHEN {{granularity}}='cumulative'
         THEN SUM(pa.orders) OVER (ORDER BY pa.period)/NULLIF(SUM(nu.newu) OVER (ORDER BY pa.period),0)
         ELSE pa.orders/NULLIF(pa.users,0) END,2) AS aopu
FROM pa LEFT JOIN nu ON nu.period=pa.period ORDER BY pa.period
